qualification.details: Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / MS from a recognized University or equivalent. OR 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MSc/MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal (As per DST circular dated 26th June 2023). Desirable: prior research experience in plant protein extraction, quantification, quality assessment, proteome profiling through LC-MS, publications, hands-on LC-MS experience, proficiency in scientific writing and lab management.

Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Research Associate I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Research Associate I recruitment is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate I post in the Gujarat Biotechnology University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate I position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / MS or equivalent, or have 3 years of research/teaching/design experience after MSc/MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one SCI paper.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate I post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 58000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Research Associate I recruitment for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate I role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate I position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Gujarat Biotechnology University located?
faq.answer: Gujarat Biotechnology University is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Gujarat Biotechnology University Research Associate I recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University or via the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.
